characterization: They cook four dishes over and over and have added nothing new in three months. Everything they finish is something they had already made before; every recipe they open cold, they close before doing anything. The dishes they abandon are not unfamiliar in method — they braise beans weekly and press cabbage under a weight, then walk away from beans-and-greens and chicken under a brick. Weekend is bread and a long pot of beans; midweek is a four-ingredient side reheated alongside.
salientInference: Every dish you've dropped in ninety days you dropped at the ingredient list, not the technique — you already cook those techniques weekly.

signals.rhythm: Weekend bread-and-beans production, midweek four-ingredient sides alongside leftovers
